metadata.title: Microsoft Is a Stock Wall Street Remains Comfortable With Even as AI Trade Skids<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
While the AI Trade Is Troubled, Microsoft Retains Its Fans on Wall Street
The artificial-intelligence trade concerns were swirling again on the back of disappointing Big Tech earnings. But Microsoft is at least one stock that Wall Street has been comfortable with. That trend has continued this week.
